title: CMM take-off basis (non-canonical consumer aid)
notice: Derived from CMM Edition 1.0 for take-off software. The release text controls: where this file and an item's wording differ, follow the item. basis_source.kind 'default' means the item gives no basis of its own and the general rule or unit meaning named in basis_source.id applies.

general_rules.text: measure the actual work to its finished dimensions. Do not add waste, cutting loss, bulking or tolerance unless an item expressly says so.
general_rules.title: Net

general_rules.text: use a stated thickness to describe the work or calculate associated material volume; do not measure thickness as a second quantity unless an item says so.
general_rules.title: Stated dimensions

general_rules.text: for an area item, deduct the area of every opening, void, fitting and penetration in full, with no minimum size, unless the item expressly says otherwise. Measure required work to reveals under the applicable item.
general_rules.title: Openings

general_rules.text: a standard bend, tee, coupling or reducer needed to complete a pipe run. It is included only where the item says so. Valves, hydrants, pits and separately scheduled components are not ordinary fittings.
general_rules.title: Ordinary fitting

general_rules.text: measure along the centre of the installed member between the stated endpoints, following its actual alignment. Do not add separate length for joints or terminations unless an item says so; an item's own fitting rule controls fittings.
general_rules.title: Installed run and centreline

general_rules.text: measure the governing face, plan area or installed length once. Laps are included unless an item expressly states otherwise.
general_rules.title: Laps

general_rules.text: measure granular layers as compacted in-place volume; measure pavement surfaces on plan; measure kerbs, channels and edging along their installed line unless an item states another basis.
general_rules.title: Roads and paving

rounding.default: nearest whole unit, half up; any positive quantity under one unit is billed as 1

quantity_policy.status: ContechCost house policy; CMM Edition 1.0 states no rounding rule
